company.name: Freebuff
company.shortDescription: Freebuff provides AI coding agents and app-building tools across terminal, desktop, web, cloud, and chat.
company.description: Freebuff provides AI coding agents and software development tools through terminal, desktop, web, cloud, and chat interfaces. Its CLI and Desktop products edit codebases from natural-language instructions, while Freebuff Web generates, previews, and deploys full-stack applications from prompts. Freebuff Cloud connects GitHub repositories to cloud sandboxes with live previews, and Freebuff Chat provides an AI question-and-answer service. The company also offers custom deployments for engineering organizations, including infrastructure-specific hosting, policy controls, retention settings, and integrations with internal tools.
